propositions: Event bodies containing credentials are accepted without screening at the write seam, allowing secrets to be published to the shared tickets branch where push protection failures wedge all concurrent agent writes.

Multiple write paths bypass append_event (txn/delete cores and reconciler's inbound_translate calling finalize_event halves directly), so a screen at append_event alone leaves Jira-sourced untrusted input unprotected.
A deterministic secret detector must live at _seam.finalize_event—the single function all event writers route through—rather than at append_event, to cover all untrusted input sources.
Refused writes must not echo secrets into the refusal message, logs, stderr, or disk, and must name which detector family and field location fired to support informed override use.

The override flag --allow-secret-pattern=<reason> is CLI-only, never exposed over MCP, records the reason and bypassed families on the event for auditability, and prevents false positives from permanently blocking legitimate writes.
